verdict.rationale: AutoGen Studio, the UI, sits on top of the Python AgentChat API. Teams built in the UI as declarative JSON or by drag-and-drop can be exported and run in Python code, components can be serialized and deserialized, and the Studio can set up endpoints from a team configuration. That points to substantial UI-to-code parity, but nothing documents that every Studio capability has an API equivalent. missing for 10: explicit documented UI/API parity, programmatic equivalents of Studio pause/stop run control and gallery import, a documented HTTP API reference, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
